subject: Analog Electronics
questionText:
A compound transconductance amplifier is to be
designed by connecting two basic feedback amplifier
in cascade. Which of two amplifier should be
connected in cascade to form the compound
transconductance amplifier?
(a)
(b)
(c)
(d)
(b) and (c)
explanation: Practice Question from Analog Electronics DPP-06 (EC/EE/IN).
